title: Payment Operations Standard for Settlement Agreements: Grace, Tolerance, Returns and Channels by Programme
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Payment Terms by Programme

Each programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements fixes how its settlement payments are treated once the settlement is accepted: the grace after a payment's due date, the shortfall below which a payment still counts as made, the time allowed to replace a returned payment, the number of returned payments after which the settlement defaults even if replaced, and the payment channels open to the consumer.

| Term | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grace after each due date (calendar days) | 0 | 3 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| Partial-payment tolerance (USD) | 0.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Replacement window after a return (calendar days) | 0 | 3 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| Returned payments after which the settlement defaults even if replaced | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Automatic debit required | no | no | no | no | yes | no |
| Debit or credit card accepted | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Retail cash payment network accepted | no | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |

## What the terms mean

- **Grace** — the calendar days after a settlement payment's due date before the payment is unpaid for default purposes; a grace of 0 leaves no days after the due date.
- **Partial-payment tolerance** — a shortfall against a settlement payment below this figure still lets the payment count as made; at 0.00 the payment must be met in full.
- **Replacement window** — the calendar days after a settlement payment is returned within which a replacement payment keeps the settlement in good standing.
- **Return limit** — the number of returned settlement payments after which the settlement defaults even if replaced.
- **Channels** — where automatic debit is required, settlement payments are collected only by automatic debit; card and retail cash network payments are taken only where the programme shows yes.

## Hypothetical illustration

Under a hypothetical Hardship Settlement payment due on a given day, the payment is not unpaid for default purposes until the 10 calendar days of grace after that day have run; under a Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement there are no grace days after the due date.
